description:
Fair Deal Property Your Trusted Experts for Residential Property Sales

Are delighted to present to you for sale this pitch-perfect bungalow residence, ideally located in Carrowpeter on the edge of Tuam town and just 30 minutes’ drive from Galway City.

This owner-occupied home has been beautifully maintained, handsomely upgraded and generously extended. With four double bedrooms, two spacious living rooms, an expansive kitchen diner and an outstanding south-facing rear garden, it offers an impressive balance of comfort, space and contemporary style.

On arrival, a large tarmacadam driveway provides ample parking for several vehicles. An energy-efficient glazed porch opens into a bright entrance hallway, setting a welcoming tone for the accommodation beyond.

The first living room is generously proportioned and features a pair of large windows that fill the interior with natural light while framing views of the open countryside to the front.

Further along the hallway, a second, exceptionally spacious living room provides a wonderful setting for everyday family life. A solid-fuel stove creates a warming focal point, while an open archway connects this room to the fully extended kitchen diner.

The kitchen offers an abundance of floor space and ample fitted units, opening into a beautifully bright dining area. Large glazed patio doors overlook the rear garden, bringing its greenery and natural light into the heart of the home. An exceptionally spacious adjoining utility room, complete with a guest WC, adds further practicality.

The south-facing rear garden is a particular highlight. A wonderful sun trap, it features mature trees and shrubs, with brick-paved pathways extending towards the rear boundary and connecting inviting spaces for al fresco dining. A separate outdoor dining area finished with artificial grass provides another attractive place to relax and entertain. Privacy hedging surrounds the garden, while views of the open countryside to the rear enhance its sense of space.

The bedroom accommodation is equally appealing, comprising four beautifully presented double rooms, each enjoying an abundance of natural light.

The main bedroom is particularly impressive, featuring wall-to-wall built-in storage and a recently upgraded en-suite bathroom with contemporary fixtures and fittings. Three further double bedrooms continue the home’s high standard of presentation, with modern flooring and thoughtfully chosen colour palettes.

A remodelled family bathroom completes the accommodation, featuring floor-to-ceiling tiling, a large double-sized shower and recessed lighting.

Throughout this impressive residence, the care invested by its current owners is clear to see. Generous living spaces, tasteful upgrades and a substantial kitchen extension combine to create a welcoming home, complemented by a garden that is every bit as appealing as the interiors.

If you are looking for a turnkey family residence within walking distance of Tuam town and approximately half an hour’s drive from Galway City, this beautifully presented home in Carrowpeter deserves your attention. With four double bedrooms, two inviting living rooms and outstanding outdoor space, it is certain to exceed your expectations.

If this sounds like you, we would be delighted to hear from you and show you around.

Brought to you by Fairdeal Property — Your Trusted Experts for Residential Property Sales.
